notes.title: Two new maps available !
notes.content:
Hey !

We added two more maps in the fight mode.

The first map is "Alpha Section" that uses the technological theme, with two generators in the middle, that will lead to a fight for the control of the central area.
The second map is "Forest Area" that uses a jungle theme. The two bunkers are separated by a large wild area.

Alpha Section
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28836961/82e5803db894f7fa96fc976d473beef744fce934.jpg[/img]

Forest Area
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28836961/92bb4c915abeb732ac1af00fed1f35932f6871d0.jpg[/img]

There are now 11 levels in fight mode and 44 levels in the campaign. 
More updates in months to come.

notes.title: Bionic Attack is now available on Mac !
Bionic Attack is now available on Mac !
Improved controls update
notes.content:
Hi, we added some cool controls to Bionic Attack !

You can now move the camera with arrow keys and middle mouse button.
Towers can now be rotated by pressing twice its shortcut (previously used arrow keys).
You can now use the control groups to center the camera on its first item by pressing twice the control group shortcut.

The space key shortcut has been improved.
With the Democratic Alliance :
- if you have a Bionic Weapon it selects it, if it's already selected, it centers the camera on it
- if you have no Bionic Weapon it selects the bunker, if it's already selected, it centers the camera on it

With the Conglomerate :
- if you have a Drone it selects it, if a Drone is already selected, it selects the next Drone or if if you have no other Drone it centers the camera on the selected one.
- if you have no Drone it selects the bunker, if it's already selected, it centers the camera on it


This update also fixes the dual screen behavior on Linux, you can now use the second screen to display something else.

Enjoy !
